<style>
#seeen-portfolio{--ink:#172c2a;--muted:#61736e;--paper:#f7f8f3;--line:#dce4db;--green:#225d49;--mint:#d9edb8;box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;max-width:1440px;margin:0 auto;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font-family:"Noto Sans JP","Yu Gothic",Meiryo,sans-serif;font-size:15px;line-height:1.95;text-align:left;isolation:isolate;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
#seeen-portfolio *,#seeen-portfolio *::before,#seeen-portfolio *::after{box-sizing:border-box}
#seeen-portfolio h1,#seeen-portfolio h2,#seeen-portfolio h3,#seeen-portfolio p,#seeen-portfolio ul,#seeen-portfolio ol,#seeen-portfolio dl,#seeen-portfolio figure{margin:0;padding:0;background:none;border:0;box-shadow:none;color:inherit;text-indent:0;letter-spacing:normal}
#seeen-portfolio h1::before,#seeen-portfolio h1::after,#seeen-portfolio h2::before,#seeen-portfolio h2::after,#seeen-portfolio h3::before,#seeen-portfolio h3::after{content:none;display:none}
#seeen-portfolio a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none;transition:background .2s,color .2s,transform .2s}
#seeen-portfolio a:focus-visible,#seeen-portfolio summary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #66965c;outline-offset:5px}
#seeen-portfolio .wrap{width:100%;max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding-inline:clamp(22px,5vw,64px)}
#seeen-portfolio .nav{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:20px;padding-block:23px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
#seeen-portfolio .brand{font-size:22px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-1px;white-space:nowrap}
#seeen-portfolio .brand span{display:block;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:2px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.2}
#seeen-portfolio .nav-links{display:flex;gap:25px;align-items:center;font-size:12px;font-weight:600}
#seeen-portfolio .nav-links a:hover{color:var(--green);text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:5px}
#seeen-portfolio .eyebrow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--green);line-height:1.5}
#seeen-portfolio .eyebrow::before{content:"";width:22px;height:1px;background:currentColor}
#seeen-portfolio .hero{padding-block:64px 48px}
#seeen-portfolio .hero-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.3fr 1fr;gap:44px;align-items:center}
#seeen-portfolio h1{font-size:clamp(32px,4.4vw,58px);font-weight:750;line-height:1.5;letter-spacing:-.05em;margin:23px 0}
#seeen-portfolio h1 em{font-style:normal;color:var(--green)}
#seeen-portfolio .lead{max-width:39rem;color:var(--muted);font-size:15px;line-height:2.1}
#seeen-portfolio .actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;margin-top:28px}
#seeen-portfolio .button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:28px;padding:15px 22px;border:1px solid var(--green);border-radius:4px;background:var(--green);color:white;font-size:13px;font-weight:650;line-height:1.6;min-height:50px}
#seeen-portfolio .button:hover{background:#174431;transform:translateY(-2px)}
#seeen-portfolio .button.secondary{background:transparent;color:var(--green);border-color:#b7c7bd}
#seeen-portfolio .button.secondary:hover{background:#e7eedf}
#seeen-portfolio .hero-note{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:14px}
#seeen-portfolio .visual{position:relative;background:#e8eee1;border:1px solid #dce4d4;border-radius:8px;padding:28px;min-height:340px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden}
#seeen-portfolio .visual::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background-image:linear-gradient(#225d4909 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,#225d4909 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:24px 24px}
#seeen-portfolio .visual-title{position:relative;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--green);margin-bottom:25px}
#seeen-portfolio .flow-block{position:relative;background:#fffefb;border:1px solid #cbd6c4;border-radius:5px;padding:16px 18px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px;box-shadow:0 8px 20px #173e2310}
#seeen-portfolio .flow-block small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:10px}
#seeen-portfolio .flow-block strong{font-size:16px;font-weight:650}
#seeen-portfolio .flow-block b{color:#76936b;font-size:22px;font-weight:400}
#seeen-portfolio .flow-arrow{position:relative;text-align:center;font-size:18px;color:#6a8962;line-height:1.7}
#seeen-portfolio .flow-block.result{background:var(--green);color:white;border-color:var(--green)}
#seeen-portfolio .flow-block.result small,#seeen-portfolio .flow-block.result b{color:#d9edb8}
#seeen-portfolio .credentials{display:flex;gap:16px 30px;flex-wrap:wrap;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:26px;margin-top:42px;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}
#seeen-portfolio .credentials span::before{content:"＋";color:var(--green);margin-right:7px}
#seeen-portfolio .section{padding-block:65px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);scroll-margin-top:30px}
#seeen-portfolio .section-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;align-items:flex-end;margin-bottom:32px}
#seeen-portfolio h2{font-size:clamp(25px,3vw,35px);font-weight:700;line-height:1.5;letter-spacing:-.03em;margin-top:12px}
#seeen-portfolio .section-head>p{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);max-width:26rem}
#seeen-portfolio .service-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px}
#seeen-portfolio .service{padding:26px 22px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:5px;background:#fffefb}
#seeen-portfolio .num{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:2px;color:#5b7f65;display:block;margin-bottom:24px}
#seeen-portfolio h3{font-size:19px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.7;margin-bottom:12px}
#seeen-portfolio .service p{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
#seeen-portfolio .service ul{list-style:none;border-top:1px solid var(--line);margin-top:20px;padding-top:15px;font-size:12px}
#seeen-portfolio .service li{padding:4px 0}
#seeen-portfolio .service li::before{content:"↗";color:var(--green);margin-right:8px}
#seeen-portfolio .work-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:0 34px;counter-reset:project}
#seeen-portfolio .work{position:relative;padding:28px 0;border-top:1px solid #aebfb0;counter-increment:project}
#seeen-portfolio .work::before{content:"PROJECT / 0" counter(project);display:block;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--green);margin-bottom:16px}
#seeen-portfolio .work h3{font-size:21px;margin-bottom:9px}
#seeen-portfolio .work .stack{display:inline-block;font-size:10px;line-height:1.7;color:#3c6954;padding:5px 9px;background:#e9eee2;border-radius:3px;margin-bottom:15px}
#seeen-portfolio .work p{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
#seeen-portfolio .work .link{margin-top:18px;font-size:12px;font-weight:650;color:var(--green)}
#seeen-portfolio .work .link a{border-bottom:1px solid #a6baa6;padding-bottom:4px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
#seeen-portfolio .work .link a::after{content:" ↗"}
#seeen-portfolio .mid-cta{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;padding:25px 28px;background:#e8eee1;border-radius:5px;margin-top:20px}
#seeen-portfolio .mid-cta p{font-size:14px;font-weight:600}
#seeen-portfolio .about-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.15fr;gap:40px;align-items:start}
#seeen-portfolio .about-image{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;border-radius:5px}
#seeen-portfolio figcaption{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:10px}
#seeen-portfolio .about-text p{font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:16px}
#seeen-portfolio .name{font-size:24px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:16px}
#seeen-portfolio .name small{display:block;font-size:11px;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:1px;color:var(--muted)}
#seeen-portfolio .facts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:18px;margin-top:22px}
#seeen-portfolio .facts strong{display:block;font-size:12px;color:var(--green)}
#seeen-portfolio .facts span{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}
#seeen-portfolio details{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:20px 0;margin-top:25px}
#seeen-portfolio summary{cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;font-weight:600}
#seeen-portfolio .career{list-style:none;margin-top:16px}
#seeen-portfolio .career li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:65px 1fr;gap:16px;padding:11px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
#seeen-portfolio .steps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:22px;list-style:none}
#seeen-portfolio .steps li{padding-top:20px;border-top:1px solid #aebfb0}
#seeen-portfolio .steps .num{margin-bottom:14px}
#seeen-portfolio .steps h3{font-size:16px}
#seeen-portfolio .steps p{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
#seeen-portfolio .contact{background:#183e32;color:#fffefb;padding-block:60px}
#seeen-portfolio .contact .eyebrow{color:#c7dfaa}
#seeen-portfolio .contact h2{font-size:clamp(27px,3.7vw,43px);margin-bottom:18px}
#seeen-portfolio .contact-intro{max-width:38rem;font-size:14px;color:#cad8ce}
#seeen-portfolio .contact .button{background:#d9edb8;color:#183e32;border-color:#d9edb8}
#seeen-portfolio .contact .button:hover{background:#ecf5dc}
#seeen-portfolio .contact .button.secondary{background:transparent;color:#fffefb;border-color:#70897c}
#seeen-portfolio .contact-meta{border-top:1px solid #526b5e;margin-top:34px;padding-top:22px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px 30px;font-size:11px;color:#cad8ce}
#seeen-portfolio .contact-tip{font-size:12px;color:#cad8ce;margin-top:18px}
#seeen-portfolio .footer{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;padding-block:24px;font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:1px}
@media(max-width:850px){#seeen-portfolio .hero-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:32px}#seeen-portfolio .visual{min-height:0;max-width:540px;width:100%;padding:24px}#seeen-portfolio .hero{padding-top:38px}#seeen-portfolio .service-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}#seeen-portfolio .service .num{margin-bottom:12px}#seeen-portfolio .about-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}#seeen-portfolio .steps{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}#seeen-portfolio .section-head{display:block}#seeen-portfolio .section-head>p{margin-top:16px}#seeen-portfolio .nav-links{gap:16px}#seeen-portfolio .section{padding-block:44px}}
@media(max-width:540px){#seeen-portfolio .nav-links a:nth-child(2){display:none}#seeen-portfolio .nav-links{font-size:11px;gap:13px}#seeen-portfolio .brand{font-size:20px}#seeen-portfolio .work-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}#seeen-portfolio .mid-cta{display:block;padding:22px}#seeen-portfolio .mid-cta .button{margin-top:16px}#seeen-portfolio .actions{display:grid}#seeen-portfolio .credentials{gap:12px;font-size:10px}#seeen-portfolio .steps{gap:22px 16px}#seeen-portfolio .footer{display:block}#seeen-portfolio .contact{padding-block:42px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#seeen-portfolio a{transition:none}#seeen-portfolio .button:hover{transform:none}}
/* Sharp commerce-inspired edition */

<section class="section wrap" id="sp-services"><div class="section-head"><div><p class="eyebrow">01 / SERVICES</p><h2>こんなお仕事を、お手伝いできます。</h2></div><p>「何をつくるか」から一緒に整理。<br>今の業務や規模に合う方法をご提案します。</p></div><div class="service-grid"><article class="service"><span class="num">01 — AUTOMATION</span><h3>業務の手間を減らす</h3><p>転記、集計、帳票づくり。繰り返す作業を、現場で使えるツールにまとめます。</p><ul><li>受発注・在庫・顧客管理ツール</li><li>スプレッドシート連携・自動化</li><li>見積書・請求書などの帳票発行</li></ul></article><article class="service"><span class="num">02 — WEB DEVELOPMENT</span><h3>サービスを形にする</h3><p>伝えるサイトから、決済や診断を備えたWebアプリまで。目的に合わせて設計します。</p><ul><li>WordPressサイト・LP制作</li><li>Next.jsによるWebアプリ開発</li><li>EC・決済・LINE LIFF連携</li></ul></article><article class="service"><span class="num">03 — AI & CONTENTS</span><h3>AI・イラスト・発信を形に</h3><p>AI活用から、オリジナルイラストや発信用コンテンツの制作まで。目的や世界観に合わせて形にします。</p><ul><li>AI導入相談・活用レクチャー</li><li>SNS運用・投稿の自動化</li><li>オリジナルイラスト制作</li><li>パッケージ・POP・動画制作</li></ul></article></div></section>

<section class="section wrap" id="sp-about"><div class="section-head"><div><p class="eyebrow">03 / ABOUT</p><h2>つくる人であり、つかう人でも。</h2></div></div><div class="about-grid"><figure><img class="about-image" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," width="707" height="943" loading="lazy" alt="青空の下に建つ真壁のりびんぐ「ふらっと」（旧高久家住宅）の外観写真"><figcaption>活動の拠点：真壁のりびんぐ「ふらっと」／ 茨城県桜川市</figcaption></figure><div class="about-text"><div class="name">尾﨑 亜美<small>AMI OZAKI / See-EN株式会社 代表取締役</small></div><p>農産物直売「やさい日和」と、交流拠点「真壁のりびんぐ ふらっと」を運営しながら、業務ツールとWebアプリを開発しています。</p><p>受発注も、在庫も、経理も、自分の毎日の仕事。自社で使い続けているからこそ、機能を増やすことより「迷わず使えて、仕事が進むこと」を大切にしています。</p><p>法人営業や移住相談で培ったヒアリングを生かし、まだ言葉になっていない課題から一緒に整理します。</p><div class="facts"><div><strong>相談から運用まで</strong><span>窓口も、開発する人も同じです。</span></div><div><strong>茨城から、オンラインで</strong><span>Zoom・Google Meetに対応。</span></div></div></div></div><details><summary>経歴・使う技術・資格を見る</summary><ul class="career">

        <li><span class="yr">2009年</span><span>インテリア商社で小売店向け法人営業。新作展示会の企画運営、提案資料の作成</span></li>
        <li><span class="yr">2017年</span><span>耐火物メーカーで製品検査・品質管理・研究職</span></li>
        <li><span class="yr">2021年</span><span>ネットショップ運営、商品企画、パッケージデザイン、YouTube運営</span></li>
        <li><span class="yr">2023年</span><span>桜川市地域おこし協力隊／移住支援コンシェルジュ</span></li>
        <li><span class="yr">2026年</span><span>See-EN株式会社を設立、代表取締役</span></li>
      </ul><p style="margin-top:20px;font-size:12px;color:#61736e">Next.js / React / Supabase / Vercel / Claude API / Google Sheets API / Meta Graph API / WordPress / WooCommerce / LINE LIFF / HTML・CSS・JavaScript / Git・GitHub / Canva / PowerDirector</p><p style="margin-top:12px;font-size:12px;color:#61736e">資格：Google Cloud Generative AI Leader（生成AIリーダー認定）、簿記、普通自動車運転免許</p></details></section>
